description: Fetch full metadata, the abstract, all revision history, JATS XML full-text links, and published-journal DOI for one or more preprints by DOI. Each DOI returns all revisions in one response, with the abstract on the latest revision only — the API keeps one abstract per preprint. Each call looks up the first 10 distinct DOIs and returns the rest, never looked up, in unprocessed[] — pass that list as dois in another call to continue; a repeated DOI is looked up once and an unparseable entry is reported in failed[], so neither counts toward the 10. When server="both" (default), each DOI is checked against both bioRxiv and medRxiv; the response includes which server the preprint was found on. Failed lookups are reported per-DOI in failed[] rather than aborting the batch, each carrying a reason (not_found, invalid_doi_format, upstream_unavailable, rate_limited) and a retryable flag; a rate_limited entry also carries the wait in seconds the origin asked for. preprints[], failed[], and unprocessed[] follow input order. DOIs must match the pattern 10.NNNN/…; a doi.org or article URL, a doi: label, and a trailing vN / .full suffix are stripped first, and results report the bare DOI.

dois.description: Preprint DOIs to look up, up to 200 entries. The first 10 distinct DOIs are looked up; the rest are returned in unprocessed.

items.description: Preprint DOI (e.g. 10.1101/2024.01.15.575123 or 10.64898/2026.05.07.723463). A doi.org or biorxiv.org/medrxiv.org article URL, a doi: prefix, or a vN / .full suffix is accepted and stripped to the bare DOI; every revision is returned either way.

server.description: Server to query. "both" checks bioRxiv and medRxiv in parallel for each DOI.

name: biorxiv_get_preprint

cap.description: The most distinct DOIs one call looks up.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `doi_not_found`: Every DOI looked up resolves to empty collections on all requested servers, with every server answering, and no DOI was left in unprocessed. `invalid_doi_format`: Every input entry fails to match the 10.NNNN/ pattern, even after URL, doi:, and suffix stripping. `upstream_unavailable`: No DOI resolved, none was left in unprocessed, and at least one lookup failed against api.biorxiv.org, so absence could not be established for any requested DOI. `rate_limited`: No DOI resolved, none was left in unprocessed, and at least one lookup was rejected with HTTP 429 by api.biorxiv.org. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

failed.description: DOIs that could not be resolved, with per-DOI error details.

items.description: A DOI that failed to resolve.

doi.description: DOI that failed to resolve — in bare form, or exactly as sent for invalid_doi_format.

reason.description: Why this DOI failed: not_found (every attempted server answered with an empty collection), invalid_doi_format (the DOI does not match 10.NNNN/…), upstream_unavailable (a server never answered, so absence could not be established), or rate_limited (api.biorxiv.org returned HTTP 429 — the same as upstream_unavailable except that the origin named a wait).

retryAfter.description: Seconds api.biorxiv.org asked the caller to wait before the next request. Present only on a rate_limited entry whose response carried a usable Retry-After header.

retryable.description: True when retrying this DOI may succeed — set for upstream_unavailable and rate_limited. A not_found or invalid_doi_format entry will not change on retry.

notice.description: How to look up the DOIs left in unprocessed, and how many failed[] entries are retryable alongside them.

preprints.description: Successfully resolved preprints with their full revision history.

items.description: A preprint and all its revisions.

doi.description: The requested DOI in bare form (any URL, doi: prefix, or suffix removed).

revisions.description: All revisions for this preprint, earliest first.

abstract.description: The preprint's current abstract, present on the latest revision only: api.biorxiv.org keeps one abstract per preprint and repeats it on every revision. For an earlier revision's own abstract, read that revision with biorxiv_get_fulltext and its version input; medRxiv blocks its article pages to some hosts, and there that request fails as fulltext_unavailable.

awards.description: Grant award numbers from the funding statement, verbatim and deduplicated — one value can hold several grants run together without a separator. Absent when none. Funder names are not included: api.biorxiv.org attributes them to unrelated organizations.

items.description: One award value as upstream records it.

jatsxmlUrl.description: URL to the JATS XML full-text.

server.description: Server the revision was found on — accepted as the server input of every tool.

shown.description: Distinct DOIs looked up in this call.

truncated.description: True when DOIs past the first 10 were left in unprocessed.

unprocessed.description: Valid, distinct DOIs past the first 10, in input order — not looked up, so neither found nor failed. Pass this list as dois in another call to continue. Empty when every DOI was looked up.

items.description: A bare DOI that was not looked up.

title: Get Preprint by DOI
